The candidate describes the foundational observability workflow (enable tracking, activate replay, configure metrics, establish dashboard, validate), while peers provide concrete implementation patterns. skill.name: AI Agent Observability Setup
skill.description: Configure comprehensive monitoring of AI agent performance, user interactions, and API usage to establish foundational observability infrastructure for tracking agent behavior from prototype to production.
skill.skill_body:
Set up observability infrastructure for your AI agent system. Enable tracking of agent performance metrics, user interactions, and API usage. Verify that session replays, real-time metrics, and live monitoring tools are active and accessible. Ensure the monitoring dashboard displays comprehensive session-wide statistics before proceeding to specialized monitoring tasks like cost control or failure detection.

## Objective

establish_agent_monitoring
## Applicable Signals

- agent prototype ready for production transition
- need for real-time performance insights
- requirement to track user interactions and API usage
- multi-agent system requiring holistic session view

## Contraindications

- agent is already fully instrumented with observability tools
- no observability or monitoring requirements exist
- observability infrastructure is already active and validated

## Intervention Moves

- Enable comprehensive observability tracking for agent performance, user interactions, and API usage
- Activate session replay functionality
- Configure real-time metrics collection and live monitoring tools
- Establish session-wide metrics dashboard with holistic agent statistics
- Validate that all monitoring components are active and data is flowing

## Workflow Steps

- Enable comprehensive observability tracking for agent performance, user interactions, and API usage
- Activate session replay functionality
- Configure real-time metrics collection and live monitoring tools
- Establish session-wide metrics dashboard with holistic agent statistics
- Validate that all monitoring components are active and data is flowing

## Constraints

- must establish foundational observability before implementing specialized monitoring (cost control, failure detection)
- session replay and metrics collection must be active before downstream monitoring tasks

## Cautions

- observability setup is prerequisite; do not skip to cost control or failure detection without active monitoring dashboard

## Output Contract

- Monitoring dashboard is active and operational with real-time session replays, performance metrics, and API usage statistics visible and accessible for downstream monitoring and optimization tasks.
